name: faq
description: FAQ section — counterpart of the panel/faq block: the accordion block with items does the same job (the faq block was merely a data-shaped accordion; on the help page the repeater had won in practice).
provenPattern: Converted from a block to a composition under the rule 'arrangement-only → template'; the look was ported from the former block component.

knowledge.purpose: A frequently-asked-questions section built on the accordion
useCases: Handling objections after the pricing band
Removing hesitation before the sign-up form
antiPatterns: Starting with every question open — the accordion's job is to shorten the page
More than ten questions — the list becomes a scanning load; split by topic
Writing the question as a heading and the answer like a heading too — the hierarchy is lost
